description:
Healing Music | Sarangi for Emotional Release

If something inside is asking to be felt — not fixed — start here. Some feelings don't need solving. They need company. The sarangi is the most vocal-like instrument in Indian classical music. Let it speak for what you can't.

Solo sarangi playing Raga Yaman (evening contemplative raga), tuned to 432Hz, with a subliminal Theta wave layer for emotional grounding and gentle release.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Solo sarangi — bowed Indian string instrument with deep, breath-like vocal quality
- Raga Yaman — classical evening contemplative raga
- 432Hz — healing frequency tuned to natural harmony
- Subliminal Theta wave (5Hz) entrainment layer
- Seamless looping texture, no abrupt transitions

⏱ Chapters
0:00   Settling — softening into the body
12:00  First wave rising
35:00  Letting it move
60:00  Tender ground
80:00  Held & home

🧠 How to use:
Press play. Let whatever rises rise. The music holds you while the feeling moves. Don't analyze it — just breathe through it. Tears are welcome. So is silence.

⏱ Best for:
• Emotional release / grief processing
• After a hard day or hard conversation
• Heart-opening practice
• Sound healing sessions
• Tender wind-down

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily uploads:
- Sitar, Sarangi, Veena, Surbahar, Bansuri and other Indian instruments
- Sessions tuned to specific healing frequencies
- Music for anxiety, overthinking, sleep, stress, emotional release
